newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended firmer while overall activity was seen as generally quiet.
EuroSwiss futures trade was closed on Monday due to a U.K. bank holiday.

"There is nothing much to say today. There was hardly any turnover. The (price) movement was very small," one Swiss-based trader said, adding however that if the German Bund futures contract can put in further gains, this should also boost Swiss bonds.
Conf futures ends up seven at 119.94.
Comi medium-term bond settled at 111.54 vs 111.49
Euro Swiss francs closed on Monday
(On Friday EuroSwiss price ended down six at 98.15)
